name: Blink imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, its skin a deep violet-crimson, faint violet afterimages trailing off its outline, glowing violet eyes, an ember in one claw

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, an ember cupped in one hand, leaning forward
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, flickering in and out of view with faint violet afterimages

attack.action: flickers violet and hurls its ember forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
